instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-08_input.step. Keep the base plate fixed at X=0..150, Y=0..80, Z=0..10. The other three input solids are loose supports. Rotate and move the 50 x 12 x 40 mm rectangular plate so it spans X=20..32, Y=15..65, Z=10..50. Move the cylindrical support to center (75,40), diameter 18 mm, Z=10..38. Move the triangular prism support so its bounding box is X=110..124, Y=20..60, Z=10..34, with material at the low-Y/high-Z corner and no material at the high-Y/high-Z corner. All supports must touch the base top face but remain separate solids; do not fuse any support to the base or to another support. Export a four-solid compound as /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-08_output.step. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
